prose: A Bloomberg analysis finding that the 30 Chinese tech stocks with the largest overseas revenue exposure returned 36% year to date, outpacing domestically focused peers. The body is paywalled and was not captured, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: in China's AI trade, the market is rewarding companies that sell to the world over local champions - global revenue as a proxy for competitiveness that domestic demand alone doesn't confer. Which stocks lead the basket is unknown from the capture.
highlights: Bloomberg analysis: 30 China tech stocks with the most overseas revenue +36% YTD
Globally exposed names are beating local champions in China's AI trade
The market prices international traction as proof of competitiveness
Paywalled; basket composition and methodology unknown
